title: Alt360 and Intapp Announce Partnership to Accelerate DealCloud Adoption Across the Private Capital Middle Market
summary: Alt360, a private markets technology and services firm focused on AI-enabled modernization for alternative investment operations, today announced a new partnership with Intapp, the governed AI platform for professional firms in highly regulated industries. The partnership will help accelerate adoption of Intapp DealCloud across the private capital and broader financial services middle market.
body_markdown:
Alt360, a private markets technology and services firm focused on AI-enabled modernization for alternative investment operations, today announced a new partnership with Intapp, the governed AI platform for professional firms in highly regulated industries. The partnership will help accelerate adoption of Intapp DealCloud across the private capital and broader financial services middle market.


[Read the press release](https://www.alt360.com/partnerships/intapp-dealcloud)
